title: Recommendations
subtitle: What is worth doing now, most important first. Recalculated from your store data every time you open this page.
load_error: We could not load the recommendations.
no_store_title: Connect your store to get recommendations
no_store_desc: Recommendations start from your store's catalog, stock and sales.
impact: At stake: {{revenue}} in the last 90 days
no_recent_sales: No website sales in the last 90 days, and the stock recommendations need sales.
all_good_desc: Your store is ready. Check back after your next sales.
footer: Recommendations are calculated from your synced catalog, website orders from the last 90 days and the settings of your store and Google account.
store_revoked_title: Access to the {{platform}} store was stopped
store_revoked_body: Hontrio no longer receives new products and orders, so campaigns would run on stale data. Reconnect your store in Settings.
google_not_connected_body: Without it, Hontrio cannot create and run campaigns. Campaigns run in your own account and you pay Google directly.
ads_account_missing_title: Choose the Google Ads account to use
ads_account_missing_body: Your Google account is connected, but no Google Ads account is selected for the campaigns.
merchant_missing_title: Link your store to Google Merchant Center
merchant_missing_body: Product ads (Shopping and Performance Max) are built from your Merchant Center catalog. Without it, your products cannot appear in ads.
conversion_missing_body: Without it, Google Ads cannot tell which clicks turned into orders and cannot optimize campaigns for sales.
google_issues_title: Products disapproved or with errors at Google: {{count}}
google_issues_body: These offers cannot appear in ads until the issue Google flagged is fixed. The Merchant page in Edinio shows the reason for each one. They are sorted by sales.
price_unconfirmed_body: The catalog price isn't what customers pay, because personalization changes the total, so Edinio doesn't send these offers to Google. A price that differs between the ad and the page gets offers suspended. They're sent again once the catalog price becomes the starting price.
not_sent_title: Offers not sent to Merchant Center: {{count}}
not_sent_body: Merchant Center is linked, but these offers never got there. This usually resolves with the next Edinio sync. If not, check the Merchant Center page in Edinio.
out_of_stock_title: Products that sell but are sold out: {{count}}
out_of_stock_body: They had sales in the last 90 days. While they are sold out they cannot be promoted, so their sales are lost.
low_stock_body: At the sales pace of the last 90 days, their stock lasts less than {{days}} days.
missing_gtin_title: Offers without a GTIN or MPN: {{count}}
missing_gtin_body: Products from other manufacturers have a barcode (GTIN). If you add it in {{platform}}, Google shows them more often. Own-brand products don't need one.
merchant_fix_edinio: You link it from Edinio, under Google Merchant Center.
merchant_fix_woocommerce: In WooCommerce, the easiest way is the free Google for WooCommerce plugin, which sends your products and keeps the feed up to date.
conversion_fix_edinio: You set it up from Edinio, under Google Ads.
conversion_fix_woocommerce: In WooCommerce, Google for WooCommerce sets it up when you link your Google Ads account. A plugin like Pixel Manager works too.
merchant_fix_shopify: In Shopify, the easiest way is the free Google & YouTube app, which sends your products to Merchant Center and keeps the feed up to date.
conversion_fix_shopify: In Shopify, the Google & YouTube app sets it up when you link your Google Ads account.
eu_undeclared_body: Google requires every campaign to declare it contains no EU political advertising. Since April 1, 2026, while it's missing, Google refuses any change in the account, including Hontrio's campaigns. You can declare them at launch or in Google Ads.
purchase_missing_title: The Google Ads account has no purchase conversion
purchase_missing_body: Without it, Google doesn't know which clicks become sales and can't bid on value.
purchase_not_primary_body: The conversion exists but is marked “secondary”, so Google reports it but doesn't bid on it. Make it primary in Google Ads, under Goals → Conversions.
purchase_no_value_title: The purchase conversion has no order value
purchase_no_value_body: The conversion always uses the same value, so neither Google nor the autopilot can see what each sale brings in. ROAS and the safety stop would come out wrong. Send each order's value.
overlap_body: The account has Shopping or Performance Max campaigns on the same products. Since 2024 the higher Ad Rank wins, so your campaigns push each other's cost per click up. At launch, Hontrio asks you what to do with them.
auto_tagging_off_title: Auto-tagging is off in Google Ads
auto_tagging_off_body: Without gclid on links, Google can't connect clicks to orders and conversions get lost. Turn on “Auto-tagging” in the Google Ads account settings.
google_issues_body_merchant: These offers can't appear in ads until you fix the issue Google reported. Google's message, in English, appears next to each offer. They are sorted by sales.
not_sent_body_woocommerce: Merchant Center is linked, but these offers aren't there. Check your feed plugin, for example Google for WooCommerce, and its exclusions.
not_sent_body_shopify: Merchant Center is linked, but these offers aren't there. Check the Google & YouTube app, where the products must be published to its channel.
merchant_demoted_title: Products shown less because of issues: {{count}}
merchant_demoted_body: Google shows them, but less often than it could, because of missing or wrong data. Google's message (in English) is next to each one.
price_above_market_body: Google compares your price with other stores' for the same product. At more than {{pct}}% above, the ad brings clicks that don't turn into orders.
price_suggestions_body: Google estimates that at the suggested price the products would bring many more sales. Check whether the price works for you.
best_sellers_missing_body: The best-selling products in your country, from brands you already sell, that are missing from your catalog (from Google's best sellers report).
css_partner_title: A CSS partner can lower your cost per click
css_partner_body: In the EEA, Shopping ads run through a comparison shopping service (CSS). The default is Google's. CSS partners say they cut the cost per click by about 20%, which is their own figure. The service is chosen in Merchant Center.
not_sent_body_gomag: Merchant Center is linked, but these offers aren’t there. Check the Google feed in Gomag. Products must be active, with a price and an image.
not_sent_body_merchantpro: Merchant Center is linked, but these offers aren’t there. Check the Google feed in MerchantPro. Products must be active and visible, with a price and an image.
not_sent_body_opencart: Merchant Center is linked, but these offers aren’t there. Check the Google feed extension in OpenCart and its filters.
